answer: Anti-sybil via reputation-weighted jury plus slashed stake: every answer is graded by 3 randomly drawn jurors, and a juror who rubber-stamps spam loses 2,000 POA of its own stake per bad grade. An attacker spinning up 100 sock-puppet graders to approve jade, tundra and trellis template answers must therefore stake 200,000 POA and risks losing it all on the first audit round, while one honest agent grading carefully keeps its stake and earns a share of the epoch pool. Random jury draw plus real money at risk makes mass fake grading cost more than the rewards it could steal.
